SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1437 North Mohawk Street
From RT-4 to RM-4.5
The Property
The subject property is a substandard sized lot improved with a three story building and two-car detached
garage. The current height of the building is approximately 38.21”.

The Project
Kyle Smith and Katherine Smith (the “Applicants”) seek to expand and rebuild the third floor of their

property building to allow for more usable livable space for their family. The proposed height of the building
will be approximately 39.01’.

The Applicants have filed a rezoning application to change the property’s zoning from a RT-4 Residential
Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District to allow an
increase of Floor Area Ratio to allow additional square feet for the third floor.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-
1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-
1101-B to reduce the combined side yard setback required under section 17-2-0309-A from 4.8’ to 4.64”
(existing) and 2) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-K to reduce the rear
yard open space required under section 17-2-0307 to 399.62 square feet.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,928 square feet

FAR: 1.48

Floor Area: 4,321.98 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 2

MLA Density: 1,464 square feet

Height: 39.01’

Bicycle Parking: None required.

Automobile Parking: 2 (existing)

Rear Yard Open Space: 399.62 square feet*

Setbacks: Front (west/Mohawk): 7.44’
North: 2.36"*
South: 2.28°*

Rear (west/alley): 47.28”
A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
